![Threat Monitor screensaver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/main/docs/screens.png)

**Bigger, easier-to-read headlines.** Every news alert now uses one large, fixed text size that fills the screen, the same on Windows, Mac and the Raspberry Pi. Headlines that are too long are shortened at a natural break, such as a subtitle, a second sentence or a trailing clause, instead of being cut off mid-sentence. Created and maintained by Oliver Kuy.

[![Download for Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Windows%20screensaver-0078D4?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/releases/download/v1.2.0/ThreatMonitor-Windows.zip) &nbsp; [![Download for macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-macOS%20screensaver-1D1D1F?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/releases/download/v1.2.0/ThreatMonitor-macOS.zip)

Install the same way as before: on Windows, unzip and double-click **install.bat**; on a Mac, double-click **Threat Monitor.saver**. If you're updating on a Mac, log out and back in afterwards so macOS loads the new version.
